[[File:Guardians CCG logo.png|thumb|Original Guardians CCG game logo.]]
In the '''Guardians Collectible Card Game''', players muster creatures, fight for the Disputed Lands and attack rival strongholds to reach the opposing Guardian. [[TCGMix]] offers a browser playtest.<ref name="catalog" />

== History ==

FPG released the original game in 1995 and later issued a Revised Edition. Its product archive lists three expansions, ''Dagger Isle'', ''Drifter’s Nexus'' and ''Necropolis Park''. The last of those was in circulation by November 1996.<ref name="guardpub" /><ref name="guardlast" /> Keith Parkinson and Luke Peterschmidt designed the game. Parkinson also contributed artwork.<ref name="guarddesign" /><ref name="guardpub" />

== Online play ==

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/guardians/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-guardians-ccg">[https://tcgmix.com/guardians/ Play Guardians CCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194452/https://tcgmix.com/guardians/ Internet Archive].</ref>
